name: schema-forms
description: Render forms from a schema definition and call D365 F&O / external APIs on submit

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
